errors.evidence: The figure does not have a label for the y-axis. The description hallucinates the label "网络密度" (network density), likely inferring it from the figure's caption.
The value of the red line at point A1 is 0.0055, not 0.0052 as stated.
The value of the red line at point A2 is 0.0052, not 0.0049 as stated.
The description states the red line rises from A2 to B1, but it actually decreases from 0.0052 to 0.0051.
The value of the red line at point B2 is 0.0050, not 0.0047 as stated.
In the description of the red line, the data point C1 (value 0.0045) is completely omitted between B2 and C2.
The blue line uses an asterisk or star-shaped marker (*), not a cross marker (十字标记).
The value for the blue line at point B1 is 0.0051, not 0.0047 as stated.
In the description of the blue line, the data point B2 (value 0.0047) is completely omitted between B1 and C1.
The description fails to explain what the red and blue lines represent, omitting the legend information: Red line is "去除偏误" (bias removed) and blue line is "未去除偏误" (bias not removed).
